---
title: "Dhop Mein Bethi Hoi Maa Yeh Sada Deti Hai Lyrics 2018"
language: "Urdu"

poet: "Akbar"

---

Dhop Mein Bethi Hoi Maa Yeh Sada Deti Hai.
Maut Aulad Ki Be-Haal Bana Deti Hai.

1
Yeh Hawa Hai Jo Samajhti Hai Tamana Maa Ki.
Khali Jhola Ali Asghar Ka Jhula Deti Hai.
Shimar Aata Hai Tu Zindaan Mein Baho Haider Ki.
Khon Mein Doba Howa Kurta Chupa Deti Hai.

2
Teer Se Lipte Hoye Hanste Hain Ran Mein Asghar.
Our Maa Khaimo Mein Jeene Ki Dua Deti Hai.
Khak Maqtal Ki Sada Deti Thi Aao Asghar.
Aaj Madar Ki Jagah Khak Sula Deti Hai.

3
Yaad Maa Ki Jo Satati Hai Ali Asghar Ki.
Aao Ik Bharti Hai Our Khak Urra Deti Hai.
Umar Bhar Jagti Rehti Hain Woh Maein Akbar.
Jin Ke Bachoon Ko Qaza Ran Mein Sula Deti Hai.

/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('src/data/lyrics/dhop-mein-bethi-hoi-maa-yeh-sada-deti-hai-lyrics-2018-tajpoints-6c080325e986a7040534.md')
_, metadata, body = p.read_text().split('---')
roman = metadata.split('romanLyrics: |-\\n')[1]
def counts(section):
    return [sum(not line.strip().isdecimal() for line in block.splitlines()) for block in section.strip().split('\\n\\n')]
assert counts(roman) == counts(body) == [2, 4, 4, 4]
assert 'direction: \"rtl\"' in metadata and 'noUrdu' not in metadata
assert [line for line in body.splitlines() if line.isdecimal()] == list('۱۲۳')
print('Verified both editions have a two-verse opening and three four-verse stanzas.')

item.text:
Reconstructed all 14 verses in Urdu script and preserved the Roman wording in `romanLyrics`. Verified that both versions have a two-verse opening and three four-verse stanzas. Updated the titles and right-to-left direction, and removed the `noUrdu` tag.

I read “Aao ik bharti hai” as “آہ اک بھرتی ہے” (she sighs), while keeping “Aao” in the Roman transcription.
